narrative.intro: National Government Services obligated $278M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. National Government Services received 8 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $34.8M and obligations up 6.6% year over year. The company’s obligations have varied across recent fiscal years: FY21 totaled $256M, FY22 totaled $254M, FY23 totaled $285M, FY24 totaled $186M, and FY25 totaled $261M. Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers is the largest market for National Government Services in FY2026 to date, accounting for $204M in obligations. Computer Systems Design Services is the second market, accounting for $64M, followed by Other Computer Related Services at $10.3M. The current-year totals are fiscal year to date and therefore partial. These figures describe contract obligations, except where specific tables list award values as total contract values. Use these figures to assess scale, concentration by NAICS market, and how FY2026 to date compares with recent fiscal years for contract activity.

sections.heading: How has National Government Services' contract activity trended over recent fiscal years?
sections.body: National Government Services obligated $278M in FY2026 to date, up 6.6% year over year. National Government Services previously obligated $261M in FY25 and $186M in FY24, after $285M in FY23, $254M in FY22, and $256M in FY21. These figures show variable annual obligations with FY23 and FY26 to date among the higher years in the series.

sections.heading: What are National Government Services' largest federal markets and contract sizes?
sections.body: Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers is the largest market for National Government Services in FY2026 to date at $204M. Computer Systems Design Services accounts for $64M and Other Computer Related Services accounts for $10.3M. National Government Services received 8 awards in FY2026 to date, with an average award size of $34.8M.
